sources.snippet: 📝 English Wa-Alaikum-Assalam! How are you? Alhamdulillah, I am perfectly fine. I have released an Urdu model trained in my own language (Urdu). It gives you a truly realistic voice and produces very high-quality audio. It is completely free with no limits — use it as much as you want.
